resources.string: Blocks selected headset, media, call, assistant, and external volume key events. It does not read screen contents or typed text.
Safe, event-driven headset button filtering. No USB claiming, root, Shizuku, network access, foreground service, or polling while the app is closed.
Android 13+: if the service switch is greyed out, open App info, tap the top-right menu, and choose “Allow restricted settings”.
Block volume keys from external devices
Block volume keys from every device
Warning: this also disables the phone’s own volume buttons while the accessibility service is enabled.

Press the IEM buttons with the screen on and off. A BLOCKED entry means Android delivered the event and the service consumed it. If nothing appears, firmware or the USB device handled it before a normal app could see it.
No recognized headset, media, volume, assistant, or call key events recorded yet.
Blocking paused; recognized keys are only logged
